scope: Lượt 25 / Bước 97–100 — current explainable in-memory Priority Engine on Consumer Blueprint + Mastery V2; no persistence, scheduler write or runtime activation

order: weeks until needed ascending with null last

reasonCodes.CRITICAL_GAP_OVERRIDE: A gap needed within four weeks is always critical regardless of weighted band.
reasonCodes.REVIEW_ON_DEMAND_NOT_MASTER_READY: Existing Competency with valid retention may reduce review priority but never grants Master-ready.
reasonCodes.MASTERY_SNAPSHOT_REQUIRED: Priority candidates require an explicit current non-persisted Mastery snapshot.
reasonCodes.MANUAL_DERIVED_FEATURE_OVERRIDE_FORBIDDE: Knowledge gap and forgetting-risk features must be derived from current Mastery state/evidence.
reasonCodes.DUPLICATE_TARGET_FORBIDDEN: Priority ranking rejects duplicate candidate or target IDs.
reasonCodes.STALE_MANIFEST_DEPENDENCY_FORBIDDEN: Historical Consumer/Mastery manifests and pinned hashes are quarantined.
reasonCodes.PERSISTENCE_DISABLED: Priority results remain in memory only.
reasonCodes.SCHEDULER_DISCONNECTED: Priority ranking does not write or activate the scheduler.
reasonCodes.PRODUCTION_DISCONNECTED: Priority remains disconnected from production entrypoints.

abortConditions: current Consumer Blueprint, Mastery contract or prerequisite policy schema mismatch
dependency on quarantined historical Consumer/Mastery manifest or baseline hash
unknown target, phase or knowledge state
missing, target-mismatched or persisted Mastery snapshot
manual override of derived knowledge-gap or forgetting-risk feature
Master relevance, derived feature or final score outside normalized range
duplicate candidate ID or target ID
Critical override not applied to a gap needed within four weeks
Existing Competency review-on-demand converted to Master-ready
scheduler, persistence or runtime write attempted
